answers.how: Shooter height is approximately 85 px and basketball diameter approximately 10 px: 85 × (24/10) = 204 cm.
Tracking the ball around 2.00 s relative to the stationary hoop gives approximately 225 px/s after correcting camera motion. Using 24 cm per 10 px gives 540 cm/s.
